question: Will global data-centre capacity exceed 250 GW by the end of 2027?

raw_reply.operational_question: Will installed global data-centre capacity exceed 250 GW on 31 December 2027?
raw_reply.outcome_definition: Global installed data-centre IT capacity is at least 250 GW (≥ 250 GW) on 31 December 2027.

assumptions.text: Capacity means IT load in GW, not grid connection requests (单位：吉瓦).
The IEA year-end estimate resolves the question when published.
